title: Mutant Puker
html:
Fire Mutant Puker

Mutant Pukers are slow monsters with a magical ranged attack. They usually appear alongside Mutant Hulks.

Race: Mutant

Class: Mage

Tip: Mutant Pukers are slow and stupid creatures. A fighter can usually "pursue" them and they will turn and waddle away rather than puking, allowing the character to hit them from the back and not take damage from them.

Notes

Poison Mutant Pukers are surrounded by poisonous gases, which damages you constantly if you stand in them. This gas doesn't disperse if the Puker dies, but wavers around the Puker's corpse until it disappears.
